verdict.rationale: Factory is primarily an agent/CLI product, which normally makes an MCP-server story 'na' (client-side MCP connections, as in factory-docs-4, don't count). However, a probe explicitly flags an official MCP server documented at docs.factory.ai/harness/mcp, which flips the axis to applicable, so it must be judged on its thin merits. There is no detail on what the server exposes, no independent corroboration, and no first-party doc content quoted beyond the URL. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of the MCP server's capabilities, confirmation it's not just client-side MCP tool integration, and independent/hands-on verification.
